coverage.scope: Fictional Lantern Docs standard exports; five supplied pages only

sources.title: Lantern Docs export policy
sources.content:
# Export policy
Status: accepted.
D-014: Standard workspace exports expire after 14 days.
Reason: keep download exposure bounded while allowing asynchronous handoffs.
D-007 is superseded by D-014.

sources.title: Historical export decision
sources.content:
# History
Status: superseded by D-014.
D-007: Standard workspace exports expire after 7 days.

sources.title: Longer retention experiment
sources.content:
# Experiment
Status: draft, not approved.
D-060: Standard workspace exports expire after 60 days.
We have not reviewed the exposure impact.

sources.title: Exposure review
sources.content:
# Exposure review
Accepted evidence for D-014: exported files can contain private draft documents.
A longer download window needs a new exposure review and user-facing copy check.

sources.title: Expiry cleanup task
sources.content:
# T-022
T-022 implements D-014: purge standard exports after 14 days.
Acceptance: expired download links return an expiry message.
